headline: Get Shrubclaw
title: How to Get Shrubclaw | The Earth Grass Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Shrubclaw is an Earth and Grass breaker, the final form of the Budclaw line. Evolve Budclaw at level twenty one, or catch it wild in Berylline Vale at levels forty to forty seven. Other forms live at Echoback Landing and The Argent Strait. The base catch rate is twenty eight percent, and stronger Aniipods raise it, with Ultra guaranteeing the catch. Need a Shrubclaw? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Wild levels forty to forty seven

description: Aniimo's Shrubclaw is an Earth and Grass breaker. Budclaw evolves into it at level 21, or catch it wild in Berylline Vale (levels 40-47). Base catch rate is 28%.
